questions.stem_text: An example of a morally impossible rule would be:

options.A: lie whenever doing so is necessary to prevent a catastrophe.
options.B: always do whatever brings about the greatest happiness.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - always assert what you don't think to be the case.
